name: set-gmsacredentialspecname-value
description: Fails if a Windows pod/workload (identified via spec.os.name or the kubernetes.io/os nodeSelector) does not define securityContext.windowsOptions.gmsaCredentialSpecName at the pod level or on every container.
remediation: If the workload requires Active Directory authentication via gMSA, make sure you set securityContext.windowsOptions.gmsaCredentialSpecName in the workload/container security context.
